occurrences.text: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.
Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
